messages:
noah: Observed a ~210ms jump in p95 for /v1/generate (prod) right after we adjusted routing weights. No deploy at that time. Screenshot: https://console.redwood/err.png
anya: Thanks for flagging. Quick theory: changing the traffic mix altered the merged percentile. We combine route summaries for endpoint-level numbers; a heavier weight on a slower route pushes the aggregate up.
frank: Confirmed in logs: per-route medians flat, per-route p95s unchanged. Endpoint p95 moved because dedidcated pool samples increased from 20% -> 65%.
noah: That's scary because alerts are on endpoint p95. Ops got paged for a non-regression. We need short-term mitigations and a long-term API/UX fix.
ops-bot: alert: p95 threshold crossed for /v1/generate at 2025-09-12T08:14:12Z.
anya: Short-term: add a dashboard banner: "Endpoint percentiles aggregate multiple routes. If routing or quota changes, numbers can move without node-level regressions." Also toggle to show per-route percentiles.
frank: Long-term API: add `aggregation` param to metrics: `sketch_merge` (default), `route-weighted`, `route-conservative` (route max). Also add `include_route_counts=true` for provenance. That lets alerting systems choose conservative semantics.
ui-team: UI idea: a subtle source-strip above charts showing sample split (hosted 35% | dedicated 65%). Clicking it expands a per-route breakdown with p50/p95/p99 lines. Also include a tiny "why change" link to a short explainer on tdigest merge behavior.
noah: Owners: anya -> dashboard banner + docs blurb, frank -> API RFC & impl, ui-team -> source-strip mock + tooltip, me -> update SLO guidance to prefer route-bound alerts or `route-conservative`. Can we land canaries behind flags next deploy?
frank: I'll draft RFC and include a compatibility note and example curl: `GET /metrics?metric=latency_p95&endpoint=/v1/generate&aggregation=route-conservative&include_route_counts=true`.
ui-team: We'll prototype ribbon and the breakdown toggle; will wire to `include_route_counts` when available. Copy: "Percentiles aggregated across routes. Click to inspect routes or request conservative aggregation for alerts."
ops-bot: note: incident annotated with event: routing.weight-change at 2025-09-12T08:12:00Z.
noah: Thanks everyone. If we expose provenance by default and recommend conservative aggregation for SLOs, we should avoid future false pagers during rollouts.
